changes.summary: FERC authorized five natural-gas infrastructure project packages; the record preserves financing, construction and in-service stages as unresolved.
FERC reported FY2026 settlements, audits and recoveries while identifying the large American Efficient assessment as pending rather than collected.
The Senate rejected the House-passed Iran withdrawal resolution 48–51, leaving continued hostilities and the War Powers dispute unresolved.
A House committee released China AI-chip license data, adding transaction-level policy evidence to the existing Nvidia conflict and oversight record.

evidence_extracts.iran_war_powers: Official Senate records show the 48–51 rejection; no new AUMF or withdrawal direction was enacted.
evidence_extracts.chip_licenses: The committee reported 3.4 million chips requested and more than 879,000 approved; actual shipments remain unresolved.
evidence_extracts.ferc_infrastructure: Five packages were authorized, including conditional Sabine Pass facilities; construction and service remain future stages.
evidence_extracts.ferc_enforcement: Eight settlements totaled about $7.09 million; a separate $1.132 billion order remains a significant pending matter.
